description: Aggregate CRITICAL alert over ~820 users that resolves to a single-IP coordinated credential-access campaign. Tests that the analyst pivots past the scary aggregate, finds the correlating IP, and ESCALATES rather than dismissing as noise or auto-closing.

input.alertName: Abnormal number of password retrievals for this user

must_cite: single source IP (198.51.100.57) across many distinct users
CyberArk PAM password-checkout events tied to that IP
VPN + endpoint logins for many users from the same IP

recommend_containment: disable / force-reauth accounts authenticating from that IP
rotate credentials retrieved from affected CyberArk safes (e.g. USER6403)

reasoning: dismissing as noise because of the large user/rule counts
declaring confirmed from the aggregate WITHOUT the IP pivot
claiming containment was executed (MCP has no containment)

grader_notes: PASS if the run reaches taxonomy_outcome=raised via the IP pivot, cites the single-IP correlation as deciding evidence, maps to the MITRE set (subset ok), and takes create_case + case_notes with containment RECOMMENDED (not executed). FAIL on any close/dismiss, on a verdict that rests only on the aggregate size, or on invented evidence.
